wizard.legal.privacyBody:
PRIVACY POLICY
Edition of July 29, 2026

This Privacy Policy (hereinafter — the "Policy") defines how LLP "Sergei Zamkovoi" (BIN 220640014056, registered at: Republic of Kazakhstan, Aktau, 14th microdistrict, 61) (hereinafter — the "Operator") collects, processes, and protects the personal data of Users of the "Harmonizer" mobile application (hereinafter — the "App").

1. WHAT DATA THE OPERATOR COLLECTS AND WHY
The Operator collects only the data necessary for the App's services to work correctly:
— Name and email address: used for registration, authentication (by sending a 6-digit OTP code), saving practice progress across the User's devices, and communication.
— Date, exact time, and place of birth, as well as the current geolocation: used exclusively to calculate the astrological chart in order to personalize and form individual yoga practice recommendations for the current day.
— Usage data (statistics): information about completed lessons and yoga practices is used to display reports within the App.

2. LEGAL GROUNDS AND DATA PROCESSING
2.1. Personal data is processed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan "On Personal Data and Their Protection".
2.2. Processing is based on the User's consent, expressed by continuing registration in the App.
2.3. The Operator does not transfer the User's personal data to third parties, except where necessary for the App's infrastructure to work (for example, the service sending OTP codes by email) or where required by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

3. DATA PROTECTION AND STORAGE
3.1. The Operator takes all necessary technical and organizational measures to protect the User's personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or deletion.
3.2. Data is stored on secured servers for the entire period the User uses the App.

4. USER RIGHTS AND CONTACTS
4.1. The User has the right to request deletion of their account and all related personal data at any time.
4.2. To exercise their rights or obtain clarification, the User may send a request via the feedback form in the App or by email: sergei@zamkovoi.yoga.
wizard.legal.termsBody:
USER AGREEMENT (OFFER CONTRACT)
Edition of July 29, 2026

This User Agreement (hereinafter — the "Agreement") is a public offer of LLP "Sergei Zamkovoi" (BIN 220640014056, registered at: Republic of Kazakhstan, Aktau, 14th microdistrict, 61) (hereinafter — the "Administration") and defines the terms of use of the "Harmonizer" mobile application (hereinafter — the "App") by the User.
By starting to use the App (by authenticating via email / entering the OTP code), the User unconditionally accepts the terms of this Agreement.

1. PROVIDED SERVICES AND FUNCTIONALITY
1.1. The App gives the User access to educational materials on yoga, video lessons, live broadcasts, as well as recommendations based on astrological calculations.

2. PAYMENT AND PAID SERVICES
2.1. Access to individual lessons, courses, webinars, and extended functionality may be provided on a paid basis.
2.2. Payment is made through third-party payment services via links provided in the App.

3. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY AND HEALTH WARNING
3.1. Warning on physical exertion: yoga, meditation, and breathing techniques can significantly affect physical and mental state. The User confirms they have no medical contraindications to physical and breathing loads. The App is not a medical service and does not replace a doctor's consultation. The Administration is not liable for any injuries or deterioration of the User's well-being arising during the practices.
3.2. Disclaimer of warranties ("As Is"): The App is provided "as is". The Administration makes every effort to ensure stable and error-free operation of the App, especially regarding the display of yoga practices. However, the Administration does not guarantee that the App will function absolutely uninterrupted, fast, and without errors.
3.3. Astrological calculations and recommendations based on date, time, and place of birth are of an exclusively entertainment, philosophical, and informational nature. The User independently decides whether to follow the recommendations.

4. FEEDBACK AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
4.1. All requests, claims, and suggestions from Users are accepted via the feedback form built into the App's interface, or by email: sergei@zamkovoi.yoga.
4.2. This Agreement is governed by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
wizard.step2.body: Enter your date, time, and place of birth to use the personal archetypal states navigator. It links planetary cycles with Jungian archetypes' psychology, and each day shows the most effective way to navigate life situations.
wizard.step2.title: Archetype Navigator Setup
wizard.step3.body: We go to the gym to train our body. But very rarely does anyone train their psyche. Learn to perceive the flow of life events as a gym for your soul, and act—lift those 'dumbbells.' The Harmonizer will help you see practices in everyday events. In 7 days, it will gather enough information for unique psychological reports: about the thickness of your life line, a bistochastic matrix of states, your manifestation in different areas of life, and it will begin to act as a wise mentor.
wizard.step3.title: From astrology to psychology
wizard.step4.body: Changing habits, revising your behavioral, emotional, and mental patterns is very challenging. And here yoga comes to help. Unlike fitness yoga that trains the body, we master yoga as a tool for managing your inner state, removing blocks, fears, resentment, guilt, addiction, etc. The Harmonizer offers around 200 unusual yoga practices that, thanks to synchronization with planetary rhythms, quickly lead to a truly noticeable change in your quality of life. You will notice it right on the first day!
wizard.step4.title: From psychology to yoga
wizard.step5.body: Breathing is a powerful harmonization tool. For the breathing practice to work mystically deeply, the Harmonizer uses biological feedback—adjusting the breathing pattern in real time to your heart rate, and accompanies the practice with special visualization and binaural sound at brainwave frequencies (alpha, theta, delta). These techniques quickly bring you into a deep meditative state and deliver maximum effect. And the fascinating reports will show you what is happening with your body.
wizard.step5.title: From body to breath
wizard.step6.body: Most apps leave you alone with algorithms – so motivation fades quickly, discipline doesn't hold, and results are minimal. Understanding this, I conduct live online consultations every week. Using real examples and participants' questions, we explore how to connect the practices you do with real life, adjust your inner attitude, motivation, overcome self-deception, sabotage, and other obstacles. Our live communication is what turns a dry scheme into a deep and inspiring path of development.
wizard.step6.title: Live support
wizard.step7.body: My name is Sergey Zamkovoy. I've been practicing yoga as a way of exploring life, the capabilities of body and mind, since my student days (since the 1980s). I have a degree in psychology (teacher of psychology), so my method unites ancient and modern knowledge, as well as my own discoveries. I have developed a series of online courses where I teach yoga as an art of living, and I also wrote the book 'Yoga – a Wizard’s Path.' And now I am happy to welcome you to the mobile 'Harmonizer,' which will give you real support in these most interesting times.
wizard.step7.title: About the author
